prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. Figures in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, pull back a covering of rough hides and look out from the top of rough pitch-black timber over a wide dry land with mountains, their backs to the camera. Bright day, clear sky. Awe. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
